qualifying_suffix.description: Appended to bare hostnames to form FQDNs. Defaults to the firewall domain when left blank.

listener_port.description: Loopback UDP port the DDNS listener binds to (kea-dhcp-ddns sends here).

tsig_enabled.description: Authenticate DDNS updates between kea-dhcp-ddns and the listener with an auto-generated TSIG key.

tsig_key_secret.description: Auto-generated base64 secret. Managed by the plugin; normally not edited by hand.

authoritative.description: Make Kea DHCPv4 authoritative: answer requests for unknown leases with a NAK immediately.

reverse_zones.description: Reverse zones whose PTR records Kea registers directly at an external DNS server, one per line: zone = server[, fallback server].

gss_enabled.description: Sign PTR updates for zones marked "gss" with GSS-TSIG (Kerberos). Needs the os-kea-unbound-gss-tsig package.

gss_client_principal.description: Kerberos principal Kea uses, e.g. DHCP/fw.ad.example.com@AD.EXAMPLE.COM.

gss_kdc.description: Kerberos KDCs (the domain controllers), separated by comma or space. Used to generate krb5.conf.

gss_domain.description: DNS domain mapped to the realm, e.g. ad.example.com (optional).

gss_keytab.description: Path of the keytab file for the client principal (readable by root only).

gss_replay.description: GSS anti-replay service. On by default: a Windows Server 2022 DNS server refused updates without it.

gss_rekey_interval.ValidationMessage: Enter a number of seconds between 30 and 86400.
gss_rekey_interval.description: Seconds after which Kea negotiates a fresh GSS-TSIG key with the DNS server.

gss_tkey_lifetime.ValidationMessage: Enter a number of seconds between 60 and 86400.
gss_tkey_lifetime.description: Requested lifetime of a GSS-TSIG key in seconds. Must be longer than the rekey interval.

gss_servers.description: Names of the DNS servers used with GSS-TSIG, one per line: ip = fqdn.

aggressive_cleanup.description: On a new address for a host, remove older addresses Kea no longer recognises for that host.

update_on_renew.description: Re-assert a host's DNS records on every lease renewal, not just on a new/changed lease. More resilient (records self-repair on the next renewal) at the cost of more DDNS traffic on busy networks. Off = update only when a lease is new or its address changes.
